newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fujitec 96/97 current profit seen up 75 pct-paper.
newsitem.headline: Fujitec 96/97 current profit seen up 75 pct-paper.

text.p: Elevator maker Fujitec Co Ltd is expected to post a parent current profit of about 7.5 billion yen for the year ended March 31, 1997, up 75 percent from the previous year, a business daily said on Friday.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the expected higher profit was due to a rise in elevator exports as result of the weak yen, and to the company's rationalisation efforts such as a cut in operational costs.
Fujitec said in November it expected to post a parent current profit of 6.6 billion yen in 1996/97. It posted an actual parent current profit of 4.28 billion yen in 1995/96.
Fujitec officials were not available for comment on the report. Many companies are closed because of Japan's "Golden Week" holiday.
